description: List USITC investigations — Section 337 (unfair import / patent) or Title VII (antidumping/countervailing duty, "Import Injury") — most-recently-instituted first. KEYLESS, needs no credential. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "what Section 337 investigations are active", "recent ITC trade investigations". Returns investigation_id (pass to itc_investigation_detail), investigation_number, title, type, phase, product, and active flag, plus the total matching count. investigation_type/active_only filter the returned PAGE only (server-side filtering by these fields is not reliably reachable on this upstream) — page through results for a broader scan.

active_only.description: Same-page filter: keep only investigations currently marked active.

investigation_type.description: Same-page filter, substring match against the type name, e.g. "Unfair Imports", "Import Injury".

sort_order.description: By institution date. "desc" (default) = most recent first.

name: itc_investigation_search
title: Itc Investigation Search
